name: Instagram
description: Instagram is a social media app for sharing photos, videos, and stories. Primary workflows include browsing the home feed, exploring content via the Explore grid, watching and interacting with Reels, searching for users, viewing profiles, following accounts, and using Direct Messages.

workflows.name: open_explore_and_like_posts
workflows.steps: Tap the 'Search and explore' tab (magnifying glass icon) in the bottom nav to open the Explore grid. Tap a reel/post thumbnail in the grid to open the full-screen Reel viewer. Tap the Like button (heart icon, resource id=like_button) in the UFI row to like it; the heart turns red/selected. To like multiple posts, press Back to return to the Explore grid and tap the next thumbnail, then like again. Do NOT rely on swiping left to advance between explore reels (see nuances).

workflows.name: open_reels_tab_and_like_reels
workflows.steps: Tap the 'Reels' tab (play icon) in the bottom nav to open the full-screen Reels viewer directly. Tap the Like button (heart icon, resource id=like_button) to like the current reel. To advance to the next reel, swipe UP on the inner recycler view (swipeable_nav_view_pager_inner_recycler_view), NOT left. Repeat like + swipe up for each reel.

workflows.name: search_for_user
workflows.steps: Tap the 'Search and explore' tab in the bottom nav. Tap the search bar at the top labeled 'Search with Meta AI'. Type the username using input_text. Wait for the results list to populate under the 'Accounts' section. Tap the matching result row (resource id=row_search_user_container) to open the user's profile.

workflows.name: follow_user_from_profile
workflows.steps: On the user profile screen, tap the Follow button (resource id=profile_header_follow_button). The button changes to 'Following' and becomes a dropdown menu, confirming the follow succeeded.

workflows.name: open_direct_messages
workflows.steps: Tap the 'Message' tab (paper plane / messenger icon) in the bottom nav to open the Direct inbox. The inbox shows Primary/Requests/General filter tabs, a search bar labeled 'Search or ask Meta AI', and a list of conversation threads.

nuances: In the Explore reel viewer, swiping LEFT on clips_viewer_view_pager does NOT advance to the next reel (the same reel stays on screen even with amount=2). To like multiple explore reels, press Back to return to the grid and tap each thumbnail individually.

In the Reels tab, swiping LEFT on the outer pager (swipeable_tab_view_pager) switches to the Message tab instead of advancing to the next reel. To advance reels in the Reels tab, swipe UP on the inner recycler (swipeable_nav_view_pager_inner_recycler_view).
The Like button's element index shifts between turns and reels (e.g., was #21 on one reel, #20 on another). Always locate it by resource id 'like_button', never by a fixed index.
The Explore grid shows reel thumbnails with view counts overlaid; tapping any thumbnail opens the full-screen Reel viewer for that specific reel, with a Back button and 'Explore' title at top.
The Reels tab opens directly into a full-screen reel viewer (not a grid). The top shows 'Reels' and 'Friends' tabs; the bottom nav remains visible.
Search results may show a 'Searching…' spinner briefly before populating. Wait for the Accounts section to load before tapping a result row.
After following a user, the Follow button label changes to 'Following' and gains a dropdown arrow; tapping it again would open an unfollow menu, so do not tap it again to confirm.
recommendations: Always locate interactive buttons (Like, Follow, Comment) by their resource ids (like_button, profile_header_follow_button) rather than by element index, as indices shift between screens and turns.
When liking multiple reels from the Explore page, use the pattern: tap thumbnail -> like -> press Back -> tap next thumbnail -> like. Avoid swiping left in the explore reel viewer.
When liking multiple reels in the Reels tab, use the pattern: like -> swipe UP on inner recycler -> like -> swipe UP. Never swipe left in the Reels tab.
After typing a search query, wait one turn for results to load before attempting to tap a result row, as the list populates asynchronously.
To verify a like succeeded, check that the heart icon appears red/selected in the next observation rather than re-tapping it (which would unlike).
Use the bottom navigation bar (Home, Reels, Message, Search and explore, Profile) as the primary navigation mechanism; it is present on most main screens.
